outcome: Agent-side GitHub Actions monitoring is now absolutely forbidden during ordinary Virtual Lab execution.
owner_impact: Future development remains unchanged at the product level: CI still builds, deploys and smoke-tests autonomously, but ChatGPT can no longer enter an Actions wait/status loop. There is no exact-SHA, exact-run or one-quick-check loophole.
remaining_action: None for this safety rule. Actions may be inspected only in a separate owner-requested diagnostic turn for a specific failure notification, with no polling.
technical_evidence: AGENTS.md now opens with the zero-tolerance Actions boundary before normal startup instructions.
CURRENT.md repeats the same absolute prohibition and terminal task boundary.
web/product-surface.json encodes github_actions_api_during_ordinary_execution = forbidden and fire-and-forget CI/deploy/smoke/report semantics.
web/tests/actions-nonmonitoring.test.mjs guards against reintroducing the old exact-run/same-turn loopholes.
Repository history shows the exact-run verification rule was institutionalized on 17 September 2026, i.e. very recently rather than as an original project requirement.
